_doc: Absolute budgets for a 10,000-event Claude Code chat session (plan 4.1). `longSession` is checked by baseline.test.ts (pnpm test:chat:perf); `render` by e2e/perf/chat-long-session.spec.ts in real Chromium. Quiet-machine numbers: run alone.

scale._doc: Opening a saved session reduces its whole history as ONE batch (useChatSession): linear in the events, Claude and Codex alike, with and without a prompt per tool call. Node, best of 3.
scale._ratioDoc: Linear: 10x the events may cost at most this many times the 10k time (quadratic would be ~100x).
